## Updates

::: {.card-list}
::: {.entry-card}
#### July 2026 | DRIFT available online
[DRIFT](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eswa.2026.133261), a collaboration on diffusion-based trajectory generation from local LiDAR observations, is available online and assigned to volume 331 of *Expert Systems with Applications*.
:::
::: {.entry-card}
#### March 2026 | GEM preprint released
[GEM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23232) samples candidate actions from a Gaussian-mixture actor, then ranks them using conservative value estimates and a behavior-support term normalized within each state.
:::
::: {.entry-card}
#### 2025 | SPTO published in IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid
[Stochastic Predict-Then-Optimize](https://doi.org/10.1109/TSG.2025.3601238) connects probabilistic electricity-cost forecasting with stochastic scheduling for urban water supply.
:::
::: {.entry-card}
#### December 2024 | Bi-correction model published
[The knowledge-based bi-correction model](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eswa.2024.124508) combines lag-penalty attention with posterior error correction for daily urban water-demand forecasting.
:::
::: {.entry-card}
#### April 2024 | CritiCoder published
[CritiCoder](https://doi.org/10.1109/TCSS.2023.3272330) appeared in volume 11, issue 2 of *IEEE Transactions on Computational Social Systems*.
:::
:::
